items.text: Doubled baseline dung production speed for cows and sheep (now every 20 m) and fixed a horse dung bug that was inflating production ten‑fold; horse dung per calorie adjusted to 0.2.
Updated harvest yields: cows now give 30 cloth, 100 leather, 100 bones, 20 beef, 40 fat; sheep now give 10 cloth, 20 leather, 50 bones, 12 mutton, 20 fat plus any wool they have.

Reworked livestock sales charts and added a random reward pool (including turrets, HQM, rifles, scrap, saddles, rope, blue cards, tarps, CCTV, targeting computers, and frags); wool chart updated accordingly.
Animals automatically dismount when the vehicle they are riding rolls over or becomes submerged.
Fixed a bug where players could be left behind during boat transfers to/from the deep sea when standing too close to a wall.
Introduced first‑pass implementation of jellyfish swarms as a new critter group.
Adjusted power phase requirements and tweaked loot spawn types; also corrected bad map topology in harbor_1.
Applied tech‑tree fixes for the biofuel generator.
Fixed deployment orientation for the biofuel generator so it now places correctly.
Added description, crafting costs, and tech tree entries for the biofuel generator.
Adjusted repair requirements for the helipad (airwolf repairable pad).
Fixed bundle purchase bug where LastBoughtItems didn't include bundle content, correcting purchase notifications and checkout results.
Fixed collider layer issue that broke groundwatch functionality.
Rebalanced sheep genetics: white sheep are now the beneficial gene variant.
Added new ferry terminal, radtown, and oil rig structures.
Increased melee protection of the waterwheel by 4–5 times.
Added muffling effect when wearing the prisoner hood, while keeping voice chat mostly clear.
Fixed fire arrows sticking to the third‑person bow for other players.
Fixed pool cue quality breaking in first‑person view when swapping between cues.
Prevented oil rigs from starting radiation while the locked crate remained untouched and ensured the crate’s hacked state persists after server restarts.
Corrected door controller rotation on single doors caused by reskin child entity mis‑rotation.
Made chicken eggs drop flush with terrain and disabled physics when terrain is found, fixing eggs falling through ground or being killed out‑of‑bounds.
Fixed cows incorrectly receiving crocodile protection.
Buildings now correctly handle multiple exteriors and interior rooms, fixing outside/inside detection.
Helipad repair requirements adjusted and prefab updated; VehiclePadRepaired condition fixed.
Single doors now rotate correctly, eliminating misalignment.
Store functionality improved: Crystal AK takeover data fixed and bundle purchases now correctly deliver items.
Biofuel generator tech tree, description, and crafting costs updated, fixing progression and resource balance.
New ferry terminal, radtown, and oil rig monuments added, expanding exploration points.
Jellyfish swarms introduced, adding new aquatic creature behavior.
Oil rig radiation no longer triggers when locked crate untouched, preventing unintended hazard.
Waterwheel melee protection increased 4‑5×, strengthening defense against close combat.
Power phase requirements and loot spawn types adjusted, and harbor_1 map topology issue fixed.
White sheep now carry the beneficial gene variant; cows no longer receive crocodile protection.
Prisoner hood muffles voice chat slightly, reducing audible range compared to heavy helmets.

2026-09-22.summary:
### Base Building & Repairs
- Buildings now correctly handle multiple exteriors and interior rooms, fixing outside/inside detection.
- Helipad repair requirements adjusted and prefab updated; VehiclePadRepaired condition fixed.
- Single doors now rotate correctly, eliminating misalignment.

### Economy & Store Updates
- Store functionality improved: Crystal AK takeover data fixed and bundle purchases now correctly deliver items.
- Biofuel generator tech tree, description, and crafting costs updated, fixing progression and resource balance.

### World & Creatures
- New ferry terminal, radtown, and oil rig monuments added, expanding exploration points.
- Jellyfish swarms introduced, adding new aquatic creature behavior.
- Oil rig radiation no longer triggers when locked crate untouched, preventing unintended hazard.

### Combat & Power Tweaks
- Waterwheel melee protection increased 4‑5×, strengthening defense against close combat.
- Power phase requirements and loot spawn types adjusted, and harbor_1 map topology issue fixed.

### Livestock & Genetics
- White sheep now carry the beneficial gene variant; cows no longer receive crocodile protection.

### Audio
- Prisoner hood muffles voice chat slightly, reducing audible range compared to heavy helmets.

items.text: Sheep now drop the wool they were wearing at death.
Lambs no longer drop dung; sheep dung drop bug fixed.
Bad genes are now more common, making generic‑looking sheep and cows prevalent; good genes (e.g., black sheep) are rarer.
Collider sizes for livestock and critters adjusted, improving hit detection and interaction.
Sheep trophy head added to hunting trophies; male calf ragdoll display corrected for female bodies.
Regular and rich mutton pies halve livestock bonding time (rich reduces an extra 30 s) and prevent bulls from charging.
Regular and rich beef pies increase max food duration by 75 % (875 cal) and boost downed‑player recovery chance to 75 % (regular) or 100 % (rich) after hunger bar is full.
Ridable horse prefab added, allowing players to mount horses.
Boat power‑down fixed when lowering sails and jumping off quickly, preventing uncontrolled drifting.
Mounting UI improvements: prompt only appears when leading an animal, slots now indicate supported size, and cows require the large flatbed.
External gate upgrades now persist; deployables no longer clip through or disappear when doors close, and fuseboxes restored on all applicable monuments.

Deployable placement respects terrain deformation with configurable tolerance, foundations align to original terrain height, oil pumps now have a 15‑minute start delay (total 35 min cycle), and helipad repair stages affect functionality.
Store UI edge case fixed when player has no items.
Crafting menu overflow resolved by reducing category button width; mini crossbow fractional reload behavior corrected.
Computer station identifier input box text no longer disappears at various screen resolutions.
Sprint animation correctly stops when a networked attack is registered, fixing visual desync.
Loadout items now use proper container placement and older loadouts default to a safe position, fixing item placement bugs.
Hair and eyebrows customization now displays correctly, fixing overridden visuals.
Remote‑controlled turrets, drones and cameras ignore base occlusion, making them visible through walls (anti‑ESP).
Squirrel critters now move at adjusted speeds, changing how quickly they flee and can be harvested.

2026-09-21.summary:
### Animals & Farming
- Sheep now drop the wool they were wearing at death.
- Lambs no longer drop dung; sheep dung drop bug fixed.
- Bad genes are now more common, making generic‑looking sheep and cows prevalent; good genes (e.g., black sheep) are rarer.
- Collider sizes for livestock and critters adjusted, improving hit detection and interaction.
- Sheep trophy head added to hunting trophies; male calf ragdoll display corrected for female bodies.

### Food & Recovery
- Regular and rich mutton pies halve livestock bonding time (rich reduces an extra 30 s) and prevent bulls from charging.
- Regular and rich beef pies increase max food duration by 75 % (875 cal) and boost downed‑player recovery chance to 75 % (regular) or 100 % (rich) after hunger bar is full.

### Vehicles & Transport
- Ridable horse prefab added, allowing players to mount horses.
- Boat power‑down fixed when lowering sails and jumping off quickly, preventing uncontrolled drifting.
- Mounting UI improvements: prompt only appears when leading an animal, slots now indicate supported size, and cows require the large flatbed.

### Base Building & Infrastructure
- External gate upgrades now persist; deployables no longer clip through or disappear when doors close, and fuseboxes restored on all applicable monuments.
- Deployable placement respects terrain deformation with configurable tolerance, foundations align to original terrain height, oil pumps now have a 15‑minute start delay (total 35 min cycle), and helipad repair stages affect functionality.

### UI & Quality of Life
- Store UI edge case fixed when player has no items.
- Crafting menu overflow resolved by reducing category button width; mini crossbow fractional reload behavior corrected.
- Computer station identifier input box text no longer disappears at various screen resolutions.
- Sprint animation correctly stops when a networked attack is registered, fixing visual desync.
- Loadout items now use proper container placement and older loadouts default to a safe position, fixing item placement bugs.

### Gameplay & Balance
- Hair and eyebrows customization now displays correctly, fixing overridden visuals.
- Remote‑controlled turrets, drones and cameras ignore base occlusion, making them visible through walls (anti‑ESP).
- Squirrel critters now move at adjusted speeds, changing how quickly they flee and can be harvested.

items.text: Building is now blocked within a radius of sandbag pillboxes, preventing structures from being placed directly on or too close to them.
Sheep automatically unlead when mounted and re‑lead after dismount, with updated mount/dismount animations.

Condition (durability) has been disabled for diving masks, crate & barrel costumes, prisoner hoods, sunglasses, geiger counters, metal detectors, RF pagers, and mobile phones, so these items no longer degrade.

2026-09-20.summary:
### Base Building
- Building is now blocked within a radius of sandbag pillboxes, preventing structures from being placed directly on or too close to them.

### Livestock & Animals
- Sheep automatically unlead when mounted and re‑lead after dismount, with updated mount/dismount animations.

- Condition (durability) has been disabled for diving masks, crate & barrel costumes, prisoner hoods, sunglasses, geiger counters, metal detectors, RF pagers, and mobile phones, so these items no longer degrade.
